exercises.title: U4 听力·对话 Meeting a Real Astronaut
exercises.speaker: uk_female

transcript.speaker: Max
transcript.text: Captain Brown, thank you for coming. What did you usually wear inside the station?

transcript.speaker: Brown
transcript.text: Most of the time I just wore a simple T-shirt and shorts. It is quite warm inside.

transcript.speaker: Max
transcript.text: Really? And how did you prepare your food up there?

transcript.speaker: Brown
transcript.text: We kept our meals in small bags and warmed them in a special microwave.

transcript.speaker: Max
transcript.text: That sounds tricky. How did you keep yourself clean without a shower?

transcript.speaker: Brown
transcript.text: We used a little water and a wet towel. A real shower is impossible without gravity.

transcript.speaker: Max
transcript.text: I see. What did you look forward to most while you were up there?

transcript.speaker: Brown
transcript.text: Honestly, I missed my family. I could not wait to see them again.

exercises.translation_cn: Max 采访 Brown 船长:站内通常穿简单的T恤和短裤,因为里面相当暖和;食物装在小袋里用特制微波炉加热;用少量水和湿毛巾保持清洁,失重下无法淋浴;他在太空最盼望的是再见到家人。

questions.stem: What did Captain Brown usually wear inside the station?
How did he prepare his food?
options: He cooked it on a fire.
He warmed bags of food in a microwave.
He bought it from a shop.

questions.stem: How did he keep himself clean?
options: He used a little water and a wet towel.
He took a long hot shower.

questions.stem: Why is a real shower impossible in the station?
options: There is no water at all.

questions.stem: What did Captain Brown look forward to most?

exercises.title: U4 听力·短文 A Day in Space
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: On a space station, every day begins by tying yourself out of the sleeping bag.
Because there is little gravity, the crew must stick their tools to the wall.
They warm their meals in bags and drink water through a tube.
Every astronaut exercises for about two hours so as to stay strong.
In their free time, many simply enjoy watching Earth turn below them.
exercises.translation_cn: 在空间站,每天从把自己从睡袋里解开开始;由于重力很小,机组要把工具固定在墙上;他们用袋子加热饭菜、用管子喝水;每位宇航员锻炼约两小时以保持强壮;闲暇时许多人只是欣赏脚下转动的地球。

questions.stem: How does an astronaut's day begin?
options: By going for a run outside.
By tying out of the sleeping bag.

questions.stem: Why must the crew stick their tools to the wall?
How do they drink water?
Why do astronauts exercise about two hours a day?
What do many astronauts enjoy in their free time?

exercises.title: U4 听力·对话 Interviewing China's First Astronaut
exercises.speaker: uk_female

transcript.speaker: Host
transcript.text: Mr Yang, when did you first dream of going into space?

transcript.speaker: Yang
transcript.text: To be honest, I never thought I would become an astronaut when I was young.

transcript.speaker: Host
transcript.text: Really? So how were you chosen for the programme?

transcript.speaker: Yang
transcript.text: I trained as a fighter pilot for years, and then I was selected with a few others.

transcript.speaker: Host
transcript.text: What kind of training did you have to do?

transcript.speaker: Yang
transcript.text: We had to learn to use space equipment and do a lot of mental and physical training.

transcript.speaker: Host
transcript.text: And how did you feel during the flight in 2003?

transcript.speaker: Yang
transcript.text: I felt calm and proud to orbit Earth for my country.

exercises.translation_cn: 主持人采访杨利伟:他坦言年轻时从没想过会成为宇航员;先做了多年战斗机飞行员,后与少数人一同入选;训练包括学习使用太空设备和大量的心理与身体训练;2003年飞行时他感到平静而自豪,为祖国绕地球飞行。

questions.stem: Did Yang Liwei always expect to become an astronaut?
options: No, he never thought he would when young.
Yes, since he was a small child.
No, he wanted to be a doctor.

questions.stem: What was Yang's job before joining the space programme?
What training did he have to do?
options: Mental and physical training with space equipment.

questions.stem: When did Yang orbit Earth?
How did Yang feel during the flight?

exercises.title: U4 听力·短文 The Journey to Mars
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Many scientists dream of one day sending people to Mars.
Using the technology we have now, the trip there and back would take over two years.
The crew would need to carry enough food, water and oxygen for the whole journey.
Mars is a cold world with very thin air, so any small mistake could be fatal.
Even so, scientists are determined to keep trying until humans walk on the red planet.
exercises.translation_cn: 许多科学家梦想有朝一日把人送上火星;以现有技术,往返这趟旅程要花两年多;机组需要带上整段旅程所需的足够食物、水和氧气;火星寒冷、空气稀薄,任何小错误都可能致命;尽管如此,科学家决心一直努力,直到人类踏上这颗红色星球。

questions.stem: What do many scientists dream of?
options: Sending people to Mars one day.
Building a city under the sea.

questions.stem: How long would a return trip to Mars take with today's technology?
What must the crew carry for the journey?
Why could a small mistake be fatal on Mars?
options: Mars is cold with very thin air.

questions.stem: What is the attitude of scientists?
options: They are determined to keep trying.

exercises.title: U4 听力·对话 At the Space Camp
exercises.speaker: uk_female

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: I'm so excited! We're going to meet a real astronaut at the space camp.

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Me too. I have so many questions to ask him.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Such as? What are you most curious about?

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: I'd love to know how astronauts sleep without floating around.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Good question. I'm most curious about what they eat up there.

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: And I wonder what they do all day when there is no gravity.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Let's write our questions down so we don't forget them.

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Great idea. This is going to be the best day of the whole year.

exercises.translation_cn: Anna 和 Tom 兴奋地要在太空营见到真正的宇航员;Tom 有很多问题想问,最想知道宇航员如何在不漂浮的情况下睡觉;Anna 最好奇他们在太空吃什么;Tom 还想知道失重时他们整天做什么;两人决定把问题写下来以免忘记,觉得这将是全年最棒的一天。

questions.stem: Where are Anna and Tom going?
options: To a space camp to meet an astronaut.

questions.stem: What is Tom most curious about?
What is Anna most curious about?
What does Tom wonder about life with no gravity?
Why do they decide to write their questions down?
options: Because the teacher told them to.
So they will not forget them.

exercises.title: U4 听力·短文 Advice for Future Astronauts
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: If you want to become an astronaut one day, here is some simple advice.
First, study science and maths hard, because you will need a related degree.
Second, keep your body strong and healthy by exercising every day.
Third, learn to stay calm, since astronauts must think clearly under pressure.
Most of all, never give up on your dream, no matter how hard the road may seem.
exercises.translation_cn: 如果你想有朝一日成为宇航员,这里有些简单建议:第一,努力学习理科和数学,因为你需要相关学位;第二,每天锻炼,保持身体强健;第三,学会保持冷静,因为宇航员必须在压力下清晰思考;最重要的是,无论道路多艰难,都别放弃梦想。

questions.stem: Who is this advice for?
options: People who want to become astronauts.

questions.stem: What subjects should you study hard?
How should you keep your body healthy?
Why must astronauts learn to stay calm?
options: They must think clearly under pressure.

questions.stem: What is the most important piece of advice?
options: Never give up on your dream.
